changes.comment: Team dissolve now writes the record closed immediately after its worktree precheck passes, then destroys every child service (Workflows, scheduler, members, leader) and reclaims the worktree as best-effort steps behind that commit, instead of stopping and closing children first and writing closed last. A member that dirties the managed worktree after the precheck no longer refuses the dissolve: the Team still closes, and a non-forced cleanup then only keeps the directory instead of removing it. A process that dies after the closed record lands now leaves the Team durably closed with whatever children the destroy pass had not yet reached, rather than reopening it. Persisted record shapes are unchanged.
